(2) A list overlay appears on the left side of the screen with several bullet points of text. The woman continues to speak, pointing towards the text. (3) The scene shifts to a detailed CGI animation showing a cross-section of skin. Flakes of skin and debris are seen exploding away from the surface, representing exfoliation. (4) A high-quality image of a young woman's clear, glowing face is shown, with a lens flare effect highlighting her cheek. (5) The camera cuts to a extreme close-up of a human nose and cheek area showing visible pores and whiteheads. (6) The original woman returns to the frame, holding a gold and white cosmetic bottle and pointing at it. (7) The video concludes with a white screen displaying a minimalist brand logo and the text 'DRX Series Skincare'.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate consumers on the specific and intense usage of 2% Retinol (A-Alcohol) for skin resurfacing. It clarifies that the product is for 'home chemical peeling' rather than daily mild maintenance, providing tailored schedules for different skin types to achieve a glowing result.
